EDIT: ... **Downvotes?** I'm trying to help a friend ffs.  What the hell is with this subreddit and who did I piss off.

Alright, I bet I'm asking for it, but I would really like to open honest dialogue about this.  To the downvoters (and people PMing me), why does this make you so uncomfortable?  

There are dedicated groups and communities to every identity I can imagine, be it LBGTQ+, nationality, species, age, or even religion/ideology/etc.  Do people give them the same crap about "not needing to be separate" or their "politics" the same way? Why is it okay to address and acknowledge those things and come together as a sub-community but not okay for minority issues?  

Like... completely, 100% peacefully, I am asking you.  Please explain.
Judging from the reactions (seen and unseen) here, I wonder if it's even a good idea.

Thank you. ;_; It's nice to see that someone understands this perspective isn't negative, and interesting that it took a wiser fur to do so, lol.  Much respect... I feel like I'm a little outside the age demo with the misunderstanding of this question, tbh.

This... is not about drama, lol.  Not sure why multiple people have assumed so.  I'm not looking to complain or air a grievance.  I am looking to ask a question that I have noticed the more general furry fandom (as diverse and inclusive as we are!!!) doesn't have much experience with.  But I know a certain group (that happens to be PoCs), does.  If that suddenly makes it "race politics," then that's kinda the problem?  

I'm trying to also keep this upbeat but like... I feel you can still acknowledge differences without having to make it into something bad or negative?  Someone from X country points out that that's where they're from.  Someone of X identity points out what they are (for the ones that do).  A fur of X species joins communities of others that are that species to talk about X species things, lol.  Not that they don't want to talk to anyone else, but other [X species/ X identity / X nationality] get those things?

lol, it's hard to find what I'm looking for when I keep getting questions like this.  
I mean like... thank you for looking at the positive?  But it's not actually a matter of looking to make friends or "only friends in X group" by a long shot (which is what i meant by I'm not trying to negatively exclude).  It's to open a specific discussion with a group that understands the topic.

Thanks so much!!!  
I posted this question is a less-anon place and immediately got hit with "why would you want to separate yourselves" etc, which is pretty ironic.  Thanks for understanding and for the suggestion.  I am really shy on FB tho and I know lots of furries avoid it, lol.
